Freeze instances to disk and put them back

### Synopsis

A snapshot holds a guest's memory, its device state and a copy of its
overlay disk, so restoring resumes it exactly where it was.

```
dicer instance snapshot [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for snapshot
```
